privacyPolicy.title: ZhiHui Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: ZhiHui ("the App") is a local-first meeting assistant. We know how important your personal information is to you. This policy explains how the App collects, stores, uses and protects your data. By using the App you acknowledge and agree to the contents of this policy.

sections.title: 1. Local-first, you own your data
items: Meeting recordings, transcription and summaries are processed entirely on your device; audio and meeting content are never uploaded to external servers;
Transcription and summary models run locally by default; you may optionally configure third-party LLM services;
All data belongs to you, is stored on your device, and can be viewed, exported or permanently deleted at any time.

sections.title: 2. What we never collect
items: Meeting content such as recordings, transcripts and summaries;
Metadata such as file names or meeting titles;
Personal identity information such as your name or contact details;

sections.title: 3. Optional usage analytics
items: Usage analytics is OFF by default and only collects anonymous feature-usage and performance data after you explicitly enable it, to improve product quality;
Analytics data is linked only to a randomly generated anonymous ID and cannot identify you;
You can turn it off at any time under Settings → General → Usage Statistics; collection stops immediately.

sections.title: 4. Third-party services
items: Only when you explicitly configure a third-party LLM or cloud service is related text sent to that service, governed by its own privacy policy;
With local models, all processing stays on your device and no third party is involved.

sections.title: 5. Your rights
items: You may access, copy, correct and delete personal data stored on your device;
You may withdraw your consent to usage analytics at any time; withdrawal does not affect processing already carried out based on your consent;
The App processes personal information in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, including the PIPL of the People's Republic of China.

sections.title: 6. Policy updates & contact
items: Material changes to this policy will be announced in-app together with version updates;
For any questions about this policy or privacy protection, contact us via the contact information on the About page.
